headline: Gold Royalty Beats Third-Quarter Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Gold Royalty Corp. reported quarterly financial results that exceeded analyst estimates for both revenue and earnings per share.
why: Gold Royalty Corp. acquires precious metal royalties and streams, giving investors exposure to gold price cycles.
